name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Claude Code Configurations for Developers
short_description: Explore a comprehensive collection of Claude Code configurations, including agents, skills, hooks, and commands. Perfect for developers looking to enhance productivity with battle-tested solutions from an Anthropic hackathon winner.
author: affaan-m

sections.overview:
Everything Claude Code (ECC) is a repository of pre-built configurations and tools designed to extend Claude Code's capabilities across multiple platforms including Cursor, Gemini, CodeBuddy, and Claude itself. The collection includes agents, skills, hooks, and commands that developers can integrate into their workflows to enhance productivity and code generation tasks. Each configuration is battle-tested and organized by platform and functionality, allowing developers to quickly adopt proven patterns without building from scratch. The repository supports multiple installation targets and provides prompt defense baselines for secure implementation. Developers can leverage these pre-configured solutions to standardize their AI-assisted coding practices across different tools and environments.
Configuring AI agents to automate data entry tasks in enterprise applications.
Integrating Claude Code into CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
Enhancing productivity by utilizing pre-built configurations for common development tasks.
Creating hooks that trigger specific actions based on user interactions within applications.
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
